newsitem.title: UK: True North TNO N says Publicis-FCB venture intact.
newsitem.headline: True North TNO N says Publicis-FCB venture intact.

text.p: A European joint venture between U.S.-based True North Communications Inc TNO.N and France's Publicis SA PUBP.PA is not at risk of being dissolved, a spokesman for True North unit Foote Cone Belding said on Monday.

The Financial Times earlier on Monday reported that True North and Publicis are close to dissolving their Publicis-FCB joint venture in Europe. The newspaper said the agreement would give the True North advertising agency control of four to six of the Publicis-FCB European offices, while Publicis would take over the rest of the network.
"The truth of the matter is all these reports are purely speculative," an FCB spokesman told Reuters. "There are no plans to dissolve (the European joint venture) at the moment."

Publicis and True North in March 1996 ended a worldwide non-compete agreement, a move which has fuelled speculation that the European joint venture might also be ended. True North earlier this month purchased Wilkens International, a German-based advertising agency network, sparking further speculation about the future of the European joint venture.
"The worldwide alliance was dissolved in March '96," the FCB spokesman said. "The alliance around Europe is still there."
Publicis separately on Monday also called the Financial Times report "pure speculation." Publicis declined further comment.
